UCLA Anderson · Reflection 05

Six Hundred Photos, One Community

Somewhere along the way, a room full of accomplished strangers slowly became a community.

1 min readJune 2026
GraduationClass of 2026Gratitude

Looking through more than 600 photos from our UCLA Anderson journey, I found myself reflecting on the last two years and the memories behind each picture.

Somewhere along the way, a room full of accomplished strangers slowly became a community.

As we celebrated graduation, I was grateful for the people, experiences and memories that made the journey far more meaningful than I ever expected.

Thank you to everyone who was part of mine.

Congratulations, UCLA Anderson EMBA Class of 2026.
